title: MMC_BUILTIN:skinvessel
description: Mesh-based (MMC) version of the mcxyz skin-vessel benchmark: a 1x1x1 mm three-layer skin slab with an embedded blood vessel, discretized as a tetrahedral mesh (1142 nodes, 6394 tets, 4 tissue regions) and illuminated by a 0.3 mm disk source. Runs the dual-grid DMMC ray tracer (RayTracer: g) producing a voxel fluence output. Use the Preview cross-section sliders to slice the mesh and reveal the vessel.
